description:
- The SMS and WhatsApp reminder options on the New and Edit task screens are now one "Messaging" section: tap WhatsApp or SMS to pick a contact (or use "Type a number instead"), and the contact appears as a tag you can tap to change or remove with its x. A task can have one contact per channel, and each channel with a contact gets the message when a reminder fires. No more on/off switches. An Email button is there as a preview and does nothing yet.
- Adding an SMS contact asks for the Send SMS permission right away, and a WhatsApp contact shows a "Link now" shortcut while WhatsApp isn't linked.
- The New task form now clears its messaging contacts after a task is created, so the next task can't message the previous person by accident.
